name: g2
about: G2, the 2-fighter scene (LIMITATIONS_FIXES_V4 3.4 step 1 / 11 Phase 2: the 24-stud 2-fighter arena the player is calibrated in across the four judging skies). One 24 x 24 stud floor with a low curb, two R6 fighters face to face at sword reach: the attacker on the effect's origin (the booth's actor, -Z forward) and the victim it strikes. A preset plays here with booth.scene "g2"; the browser player (kit/vfx/player/player.js) and the Studio booth (kit/vfx/booth.luau) build the SAME layout from this file, so their recordings are of one scene. Effect space: x right, y up, -z forward, studs. Checked by kit/vfx/duel.py (the arena 24 studs, both fighters whole inside it and facing each other within reach, every view seeing both whole).
